whenToUse: The start screen of a service that wants fewer sign-up steps.
The accounts your audience uses are well known.
whenNotToUse: You'd request many permissions without needing the outside account's data.
There are more than five buttons.
Work tools that use company accounts only (use a single SSO button).

alternatives.name: Loading Button
alternatives.reason: The in-progress state of a single button.

accessibility: Put the account name in text in each button name so they aren't told apart by logo alone.
The connecting button is marked aria-busy and the rest disabled.
The logo placeholders are decorative, so they're aria-hidden.
Buttons are 44px tall so they're easy to press.
